class.name: SfxStreamLoopSupport
class.description: Static helpers over the stream types that loop.

method.name: get_loop_region
method.description: Where the stream wraps, in seconds: [code]x[/code] the loop's start, [code]y[/code] its end.

method.name: set_looping
method.description: Turns the loop of [param stream] on or off.

method.name: set_persisted_loop_offset
method.description: Sets the stored loop offset; [code]false[/code] when the type has none.

method.name: supports_persisted_loop_offset
method.description: Whether the stream type stores a loop offset.
